title: Concept: InfluxDB UI console is reachable without authentication
description: InfluxDB 2.x serves its UI from the same port as the write and query API. If the UI loads without a login, the API behind it is usually unauthenticated as well, so the caller reads every bucket and can mint tokens.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller reads metrics that often carry host and user identifiers, and can create an API token for later access.
